object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: CI's wheel smoke job runs --version without checking the output. Run the installed mellon-mcp --version three ways: with the working directory outside any repository, with --repo-root naming a non-repository folder, and with CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR naming a missing folder. Expected: each run writes exactly 'mellon-mcp <version>' and a line break to standard output, where <version> is the package's version, and exits 0. Probe: 'mellon-mcp 0.3.0', status 0, outside a repository.
